title: Nondegenerate simplex subcategory is a poset with unique factorization
statement: Use simplicial sets, standard simplices and ordinary nerves of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $X$ be a small simplicial set. A simplex is nondegenerate if it is not obtained from a lower-dimensional simplex by a nonidentity surjective simplex operator. Suppose every nondegenerate simplex $\Delta^n\to X$ is a monomorphism, meaning injective in every degree. Let $\mathsf S(X)$ be the ordinary category whose objects are all simplices $\sigma:\Delta^n\to X$ and whose morphisms $\sigma\to\tau$ are monotone maps $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$ satisfying $\tau\Delta(\alpha)=\sigma$, with composition of monotone maps. Let $B_X$ be the full subcategory on the nondegenerate simplices. Then there is at most one morphism between any two objects of $B_X$, every such morphism is represented by an injective monotone map, and existence of a morphism defines a partial order on its objects. For any simplex $\sigma$, write $\sigma=\bar\sigma\Delta(s_\sigma)$ for its unique nondegenerate decomposition of [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-set-nondegenerate-decomposition], with $s_\sigma$ surjective. Every morphism $\alpha:\sigma\to\tau$ with $\tau$ nondegenerate factors uniquely as $\sigma\xrightarrow{s_\sigma}\bar\sigma\xrightarrow{t}\tau$; that is, $\alpha=t\circ s_\sigma$ with $\tau\Delta(t)=\bar\sigma$.
